audited_implementation.theoretical_foundation: Cameron, Gelbach, & Miller (2011) multi-way clustering bootstrap framework for non-nested crossed grouping factors
audited_implementation.resampling_scheme: Two-way independent multinomial cluster resampling on candidates (C=91) and jobs (J=52)
audited_implementation.cluster_weighting_mechanism: w_i = c_counts[cand(i)] * j_counts[job(i)] where c_counts ~ Multinomial(C, 1/C) and j_counts ~ Multinomial(J, 1/J)

forensic_methodological_checks.crossed_cluster_mechanism: Candidate clusters and job clusters are resampled independently with replacement. A pair (c, j) receives non-zero weight if and only if both candidate c and job j are selected in the respective cluster resamples.
forensic_methodological_checks.alignment_mechanism: Predictions from challenger and comparator are indexed by pair row i. The paired accuracy difference Delta_i = I(challenger_i == y_i) - I(comparator_i == y_i) is evaluated directly on pair i, ensuring perfect paired alignment for every resampled pair.
forensic_methodological_checks.duplicate_cluster_handling: Duplicate selections of candidate c (k_c > 1) and job j (k_j > 1) scale the pair weight multiplicatively: w_i = k_c * k_j. This correctly represents the joint cluster multiplicity.
forensic_methodological_checks.incidence_mechanism: The sparse bipartite graph structure of 296 pairs across 91 candidates and 52 jobs is strictly preserved because weights only apply to existing pairs E in the graph. No synthetic unobserved pairs are generated.

finite_cluster_correction.impact_assessment: Because the finite-sample correction inflates standard error by 1.52%, it slightly widens the confidence intervals, further reinforcing that 95% CIs span zero.

interval_methodology_audit.percentile_interval_validity: Percentile intervals are transformation-invariant and robust for bounded proportions. Basic (empirical pivotal) intervals yield virtually identical bounds (e.g. Seed 42 vs Baseline: Percentile [-1.34%, +19.92%], Basic [-1.68%, +19.58%]).

comparator_a_production_baseline.confidence_interval_conclusion: 95% CIs cross zero for all 5 seeds due to two-way cluster variance inflation (SE ~5.5-6.2% vs unclustered ~2.9%).

comparator_b_raw_sbert.confidence_interval_conclusion: 95% CIs cross zero for all 5 seeds due to two-way cluster variance inflation.
